nodes.label: Memlog-Derived Specification
nodes.rationale: The append-only memlog is the decision record; SPEC.md and spec-authored companions are re-derived so multiple upstream workflows can update the contract without merge drift.

nodes.label: Reliable Business Action Safety
nodes.rationale: Material actions require preparation, validation, confirmation where needed, idempotent execution, receipts, and reconciliation of unknown outcomes; ambiguous results must never be reported as success.

nodes.label: Two-Domain Platform Proof
nodes.rationale: The first release is proven only when one shared core operates both the autoparts and Montagio service pilots, followed by a third independent tenant without core changes or a client fork.

nodes.source_location: Staffy — декомпозиция на эпики и истории

nodes.label: Go Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: A six-module Go monolith keeps transactions, module ownership, and pilot operations simple while a separately replaceable media edge preserves future scaling and isolation options.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Scoped Admission
nodes.rationale: Only exact, current, scoped PASS instances grant permission; missing, failed, expired, or inapplicable evidence cannot broaden a route and all applicable gates are conjunctive.

nodes.label: Research Plan Gate
nodes.rationale: The single approval gate fixes the decision, dimensions, topology, budgets, source surfaces, and time estimate before research fan-out begins.

nodes.label: Research Firewall
nodes.rationale: Project context may shape research questions but cannot serve as evidence; every report claim must trace to a retrieved digest or imported source.

nodes.label: Staged Media Infrastructure Adoption
nodes.rationale: Pion supplies WebRTC primitives rather than SIP, PBX, transcoding, recording, and HA; Staffy should adopt Asterisk or LiveKit SIP first and replace only a measured bottleneck.

nodes.label: Staffy Voice and Omnichannel Architecture Research
nodes.norm_label: staffy voice and omnichannel architecture research
nodes.source_location: Staffy: минимальная platform, voice и omnichannel architecture

nodes.label: Narrow Vertical Wedge Decision
nodes.rationale: Horizontal voice-agent features are already crowded and commoditizing, so Staffy should validate a narrow transaction-completing vertical before building a universal platform or proprietary media engine.

nodes.label: Measurement-Gated Go Data Plane Trigger
nodes.rationale: Broader Go ownership should follow only if a controlled far-end benchmark demonstrates material latency and all-in cost improvement at matched quality and reliability under realistic PSTN and interruption workloads.

nodes.label: Owned Control Plane with Replaceable Media Edge
nodes.norm_label: owned control plane with replaceable media edge
nodes.rationale: Staffy should own tenant state, policy, actions, connectors, audit, and evaluation while buying or swapping telephony and realtime media components until measurements justify a narrower owned Go data plane.

nodes.norm_label: build auto edge case hunter review

nodes.norm_label: code review edge case hunter review

nodes.norm_label: present and act on review findings

nodes.label: Version-Gated External Action
nodes.rationale: An order action must remain blocked when the ABCP version differs from the version reviewed and confirmed by the customer and manager; the user must reconcile the material delta before proceeding.

nodes.label: Missing Evidence Rule
nodes.rationale: Every analysis must disclose missing inputs and narrow its scope so readers can distinguish checked-and-clean results from areas never checked.

nodes.label: Evidence-Grounded Team Discussion
nodes.rationale: Multiple perspectives may discuss only sourced findings so retrospective dialogue produces systemic understanding without inventing events or patterns.

nodes.label: Requirements Extraction
nodes.source_location: Step 1: Validate Prerequisites and Extract Requirements

nodes.source_location: Correct Course - Sprint Change Management Workflow

nodes.label: Path Forward Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Compare direct adjustment, rollback, and MVP review by effort, risk, timeline, sustainability, stakeholder expectations, and business value before recommending a course.

nodes.label: User-Value-First Epic Organization
nodes.rationale: Epics are organized around complete user outcomes rather than technical layers so each increment independently delivers meaningful value and can enable later work.

nodes.label: Sequential Story Dependency Principle
nodes.rationale: Each story must be completable from prior work without depending on a future story, keeping implementation order executable by a single development agent.

nodes.label: Go Realtime Stream Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Go is recommended for predictable concurrency, mature WebRTC support, simpler operations than Rust, and latency far below the STT, LLM, and TTS bottlenecks.

nodes.label: Russian Compliance Architecture
nodes.rationale: Keep voice, personal, and potentially biometric data in a Russian-controlled or on-premises contour; avoid direct dependence on foreign STT, TTS, LLM, and media services.

nodes.label: Vertical Market Entry Strategy
nodes.rationale: Start with deeply integrated medical and automotive-parts use cases, sell an outcome rather than a generic bot builder, then expand toward SaaS.

nodes.label: PRFAQ Distillate
nodes.rationale: Preserve rejected framings, requirements signals, constraints, competitive context, scope signals, risks, and open questions as token-efficient input for downstream PRD creation.

nodes.label: Product Brief Memlog
nodes.rationale: An append-only canonical memory and audit trail prevents decisions, changes, overrides, assumptions, and events from being lost across resumptions.

nodes.label: Visible AI Employee Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Staffy should expose build, test, publish, monitor, and improve as an understandable employee lifecycle, with explicit simulation, controlled, and live states instead of technical menus or a single undifferentiated publish action.

nodes.label: Agent Instruction Admission Test
nodes.rationale: Include instructions according to the cost and likelihood of retrieval failure and whether a rule must hold, rather than whether an agent could theoretically derive it.

nodes.label: Controlled Business Actions
nodes.rationale: Free-form conversation remains flexible while side effects are limited to typed actions with validation, authorization, idempotency, risk-based approval, and reconciliation.

nodes.rationale: Expand only against tokens actually present in graph labels because the query matcher has no stemming, synonym expansion, or cross-language matching.

nodes.label: Saved Query Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Saving answers, cited nodes, outcomes, corrections, and expansion history makes later graph updates and reflections prefer useful sources and avoid known dead ends.

nodes.label: Sparse Override Resolution
nodes.rationale: Customization files contain only changed fields and merge through base, team, then user layers so policies and personal preferences remain separately maintainable.
